objectives.text: Find the card with two orange circles that is 2 tiles from a short blue house that is next to a short yellow house.
Find the card with two blue hearts that is next to a short grey house that is next to a rock.
Find the card with one blue diamond that is 2 tiles from a rock that is 2 tiles from a tall blue house.
Find the card with two blue plusses that is 2 tiles from a tall red house that is beside a short red house.
Find the card with two green circles that is beside a tall blue house that is beside a short yellow house.
Find the card with one red circle that is 2 tiles from a rock that is 2 tiles from a short yellow house.
Find the card with two orange stars that is 2 tiles from a tree that is beside a tall red house.
Find the card with one black star that is beside a short red house that is next to a tall red house.
Find the card with one orange diamond that is beside a tall blue house that is 2 tiles from another tall blue house.
Find the card with one red heart that is beside a tall blue house that is 2 tiles from a short grey house.
Find the card with two green stars that is 3 tiles from a tall red house that is 2 tiles from another tall red house.
Find the card with one black circle that is next to a short blue house that is next to a rock.
Find the card with one green square that is 3 tiles from a rock that is 3 tiles from a tall blue house.
Find the card with two red diamonds that is 2 tiles from a short yellow house that is 2 tiles from another short yellow house.
Find the card with one red square that is beside a short yellow house that is next to a tall blue house.
